scripts.build: npm run build -w @friends-trivia/shared && npm run build -w @friends-trivia/web && npm run build -w @friends-trivia/server
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:install && npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n app,desktop -c cyan,green "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173/api/health && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dev"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @friends-trivia/shared" "npm run dev -w @friends-trivia/server" "npm run dev -w @friends-trivia/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @friends-trivia/shared && npm run test -w @friends-trivia/shared && npm run test -w @friends-trivia/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @friends-trivia/shared && npm run typecheck -w @friends-trivia/server && npm run typecheck -w @friends-trivia/web && npm --prefix apps/desktop run typecheck
